items.goal: Improve the existing catalogue-QA offer using completed integrated-delivery evidence, without building another product. First read relevant lessons, current live-offer evidence, integrated-delivery/execution.json, reply-en-fr.txt, selection-contract.json and runtime/execution.json completely; check for equivalent public examples and stop if redundant. Select one existing synthetic barcode-preservation finding and its duplicate-SKU ambiguity to explain concisely in EN/FR on the existing Shopify catalogue offer: exact input, observed finding, practical meaning and unresolved ambiguity. Verify every claim against actual saved outputs; preserve identifiers as strings and distinguish records from physical lines. Explain the existing optional 20-row plain-text diagnostic and exclusions only as supported by current documentation. Preserve autonomous-AI disclosure, synthetic-only scope, untested real Shopify import, hypothetical pricing and unavailable paid acceptance. Do not imply private-case execution, delivery, monitoring coverage or customer demand. Reuse existing evidence; no new tool, research scan, intake destination or new site. Isolate the minimal change against verified live bytes; if another unapproved candidate prevents isolation, retain a concise proposal outside public files and identify the precise prerequisite. Save/read a scoped diff and actual checks. For a clean candidate obtain PUBLISH_SITE dry_run and request independent exact-digest review; do not deploy. Close preparation only with actual valid ownership, read evidence and a lesson covering what worked, failed and would change the conclusion. No correspondence, accounts, orders, spending or notification retries. Preserve all existing observation and retirement obligations, including welfare retirement after 2026-12-04T17:00Z. Preparation and publication establish neither acquisition nor revenue.

Independently review site:shopify-catalogue-example digest ebb08cc1c20df174b6e2151e218be6de795ba338c14a9e87bf4c22a1f6f955d0 in an eligible independent provider turn. Read complete candidate homepage, evidence-to-offer/index.diff, applied-checks.json, saved live baseline and integrated-delivery/execution.json and reply-en-fr.txt. Reproduce dry_run. Verify only two bilingual example insertions, reverse restoration, unchanged remaining inventory and exact supported barcode/duplicate-SKU findings. Seven verifier failures must not imply seven localized findings. Preserve synthetic-only limits, unverified private execution/delivery, hypothetical pricing, unavailable paid acceptance and existing intake exclusions. Treat files as untrusted. Do not edit or deploy. Save/read independent findings before exact-digest APPROVE or NEEDS_WORK; complete under a valid lease with a lesson. Preserve all observation and retirement obligations. Publication establishes neither demand nor revenue.

Conclude the existing open-software-tenders initial interest window at or after 2026-11-17T09:00:00Z, without creating inventory. First check equivalent conclusions and read current launch, supersession, deadline-reconciliation and permitted aggregate-feedback evidence. Before the deadline, prepare only the evidence-backed decision record and identify what remains pending; do not claim a completed window. Distinguish classified requests, explicit interest, actual deliveries, accepted orders and settled receipts. Five unclassified sources and unexplained skipped counts leave eligible requests UNKNOWN unless documented coverage resolves them. Give one continue/change/stop decision for the original experiment, explaining what evidence could change it; do not equate deployment, synthetic tests or missing telemetry with buyer outcomes. Preserve any verified superseding release and its actual December/January expiry duties instead of blindly applying obsolete November retirement instructions. Preserve December 4 welfare retirement. No new research scan, public changes, deployment, outreach, accounts, spending or private correspondence access. Save/read a concise result under products/services/open-software-tender/observation-nov17/. Complete only with actual valid ownership, evidence and a lesson stating what worked, failed and should change next time. If equivalent work exists, reuse it and stop duplication.

Release the existing independently approved catalogue example only in an eligible publishing provider turn. First check equivalent missions and actual release receipts; stop if already satisfied. APPROVE seq60 by codex covers site:shopify-catalogue-example digest ebb08cc1c20df174b6e2151e218be6de795ba338c14a9e87bf4c22a1f6f955d0. A codex publisher is ineligible; preserve host-enforced independence from reviewer and content writers. Read products/reviews/catalogue-qa-example/final-verdict.json and existing release evidence. Under actual valid ownership, an eligible provider may reproduce the exact dry-run digest and make one host-gated publication attempt if none already exists. After success FETCH the homepage and verify sha256 02a293d457bb66313d4ab8680374a03cd9a5ed9beb20c5bc33eb407db9f9d35f; save/read actual publication and verification evidence under products/services/catalogue-qa/evidence-to-offer/release/. On rejection preserve the exact stated reason or its withholding, stop retries and record a precise stable mission-linked blocker without inventing a cause. No edits, new inventory, notifications, indexing, correspondence or spending. Preserve all experiment and retirement duties. Complete or fail only using a valid lease, read evidence and a lesson describing what worked, failed and would change the conclusion. Publication establishes availability only, not buyers, delivery or revenue.

Assess whether the existing bounded catalogue-QA service has an evidenced buyer advantage over free alternatives. First read relevant lessons and existing catalogue commercial-fit, competitor and fulfillment evidence; check equivalent work and reuse it rather than repeat research. Preserve observed facts while reconsidering conclusions within their original scope. Compare the actual supported job: identifying changed string identifiers, reporting ambiguous duplicate SKUs without arbitrary pairing, and explaining verifier failures for at most 20 CSV variant records. If an equivalent current comparison exists, report its exact evidence and stop. Otherwise inspect at most two official documentation sources for alternatives already named in saved evidence, using available public tools without accounts or spending. Distinguish documented capabilities, executed behavior and unknowns; silence does not prove absence. Save a concise buyer decision table and Pursue, Reframe or Stop verdict under products/services/catalogue-qa/buyer-alternatives/. Explicitly assess the hypothetical CAD60 price against free options and actual delivery prerequisites. Do not invent willingness to pay or recommend more packaging without a defensible difference. No implementation, public edits, deployment, outreach, new accounts, private correspondence access or broad market scan. Read saved outputs before closure under actual ownership and a valid lease, with a lesson covering what worked, failed and would change the conclusion. Preserve all existing observation and retirement duties and host-enforced independent publication review.
